title: QA-TRACKER
description: Local QA evidence. To capture, select the current tab in the browser picker.
delayedCapture: Shift + click to capture after a 5-second delay following screen permission.
captureDelayStarted: Capturing in 5 seconds. Reopen the menu or hover over the element you want to capture.
moveCapture: Drag to move or use the arrow keys. Press Enter or Space to capture.
captureError: Could not capture the tab. Please try again.
storageError: Could not access evidence. Check browser storage and try again.
permission: Permission denied or selection cancelled. Authorize the operation to continue.
unsupported: This feature requires HTTPS or localhost and a compatible browser.
selectTab: Select the current tab, not a window or the entire screen.
quota: Not enough space to save the screenshot. Delete evidence and try again.
blocked: Storage is blocked. Close other application tabs and try again.
routeChanged: The view changed during capture. Evidence was not saved; please capture again.
copyError: Could not copy the image. Check clipboard permissions.
confirmClear: Delete all evidence from this browser?
empty: No evidence yet. Use the camera button to save your first screenshot.

external.title: External QA platform
external.label: QA link
external.invalidUrl: Enter an HTTPS URL from the allowed origin.
external.instructions: Copy an image, select the platform field and paste. If the page does not appear, open it in another tab.
external.empty: Enter a QA-TRACKER link to get started.
